description: This two-level sunburst or donut chart illustrates a hierarchical categorization of tasks, featuring an inner ring with three primary categories and an outer ring with nine specific sub-categories. The inner ring consists of "Contradiction Resolution" (brownish-red), "Context Tracking" (dark blue), and "Context Retrieving" (dark teal), with their labels written in bold white text directly inside the segments. The outer ring expands on these primary categories with corresponding colored slices, each labeled externally with a name and a numerical value connected by a thin blue line. Adjacent to "Contradiction Resolution" are "Prioritization" (light red, 100), "Personalization" (orange-red, 100), and a visually blurred label (bright red, 111). Adjacent to "Context Tracking" are "Triggering" (light blue, 100), "Recursive Reasoning" (medium blue, 110), and "Dynamic Environment" (medium-dark blue, 100). Adjacent to "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light cyan, 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (turquoise, 100), and "Multitasking" (green, 160). The chart does not include a separate legend or percentage labels, relying instead on the external numerical values to indicate proportion. The segments are separated by white borders around a hollow center and are not ordered by size, although the "Multitasking" slice is visually the largest in the outer ring.
